items.title: An update on independent evaluators
items.detailText:
Anthropic announces updates to embedding independent evaluators
Last month, we committed to stronger independent, third-party assessment of our models and safety practices. We also signed the White House Accord on Super Intelligence, in which companies pledged to partner with independent external auditors or evaluators. Today, we’re announcing that we’ve started to give employee-like access to a team from METR , a nonprofit that evaluates frontier AI models.
METR will publish the results of its risk assessments. Over the past year, we’ve worked with METR on several reviews of our Risk Reports . We’re also working with SecureBio and Accenture as evaluators, and are in early discussions with several other organizations, including Hugging Face .
Here, we explain our approach to working with evaluators.
To evaluate frontier models, evaluators need the following:
Although the analogy isn’t exact, bank supervision operates on similar logic. Banks know more about their own risk positions than outsiders do, so regulators assign resident examiners to work inside the largest banks. If a bank’s risk-taking could threaten the public, third parties try to see that in advance.
For the AI industry, this is a step toward robust safety oversight . We’re moving quickly with multiple evaluators and learning actively about what kinds of partnership work. We’re committed to sharing updates as we go.
We’ve onboarded six METR employees with company hardware, office space, and access to internal tools and systems that are roughly on par with what our own risk assessment teams have access to. Outside a small number of clearly defined categories (e.g., data about customers, attorney-client privileged information, or information about our model architectures), Anthropic employees are encouraged to share information with them just as they would with a fellow employee working on alignment risk. 1
METR will publish its analysis of our risk levels, incidents, or practices. Anthropic can’t veto publication, but we can require them to redact information if it falls into predefined categories such as reproducing confidential IP. (Anthropic ultimately decides what information does and does not fall into these categories, although METR reserves the right to make certain statements about the level of access and information it received.) 2
Our engagement with METR is limited to a small team operating under enforceable agreements. Other METR employees are siloed from that team’s work, including researchers who work with us on other projects. Embedded evaluation gives a few qualified people working under Anthropic’s security standards a close view of how we operate. It’s not a way for other organizations to obtain our information, or that of our customers and partners.

items.title: Anthropic has opened an office in Singapore and signed an MOU with the country’s government to advance safe, responsible AI adoption.
items.detailText:
Anthropic opens its fifth Asia-Pacific office in Singapore and signs an MOU with the government on AI safety, evaluation, and responsible adoption.
“We’re committed to Singapore for the long term,” said Dale Finlay, General Manager of ASEAN at Anthropic. “Our customers here hold AI to an extremely high standard, especially when it comes to reliability and security. Having a team on the ground means we can get even closer to the organizations putting Claude to work on their hardest problems.”
“Singapore has been a leader in responsible AI, with a long track record of investment in model testing and evaluation,” said Mann. “We founded Anthropic on the belief that capability and safety have to go hand in hand. With this MOU, we’ll partner with Singapore to help ensure the transition to powerful AI goes well here, across Asia-Pacific, and around the world.”
“Singapore’s approach to AI has always been to enable innovation while keeping pace with its evolving risks. Trust is critical for businesses, workers, and the public to use AI with confidence,” said Chng. “This partnership with Anthropic reflects the Government’s commitment to scaling up the responsible adoption of AI, deepening capabilities in our companies and government agencies, and delivering impact for Singapore.”
Our work with Singapore goes back to 2023, when we joined the Generative AI Evaluation Sandbox run by the Infocomm Media Development Authority and the AI Verify Foundation. We later partnered with them on a red-teaming project in English, Mandarin, Malay, and Tamil.
Under the MOU, we plan to hold technical exchanges with Singapore’s AI safety, security, and assurance institutions on model evaluation, testing standards, and incident response. We do similar work with safety institutes around the world, where sharing technical information provides governments with a clearer view of frontier AI capabilities and risks, while helping developers build safer models.
We’ll also look for ways to strengthen AI skills in Singapore, help small and medium-sized businesses adopt AI responsibly, and support the government’s goal of building AI capability among public officers. We plan to share research and data with the government, including from the Anthropic Economic Index , and to offer technical and policy expertise as Singapore develops its rules for AI.
In our latest Economic Index , Singapore ranks second of 121 countries in Claude.ai usage relative to its population, at nearly six times what its size alone would predict.

items.title: Introducing Muse Spark 1.1
items.detailText:
Today, we’re excited to introduce Muse Spark 1.1, the latest model from Meta Superintelligence Labs and a significant upgrade from Muse Spark. Muse Spark 1.1 is a multimodal reasoning model built for agentic tasks, with major gains in tool and computer use, coding, and multimodal understanding.
With these improvements, Muse Spark 1.1 advances the performance-efficiency frontier. Together with this week’s launch of Muse Image , this release brings us closer to our vision of personal superintelligence: models that help you pursue your goals, create what you imagine, deepen your relationships, and take action on what you value most.
Along with this release, we are launching a public preview of the new Meta Model API where developers can access Muse Spark 1.1. The model is available now in "Thinking" mode in the Meta AI app and on meta.ai .
For more details about our evaluations, see our report .
Muse Spark 1.1 delivers exceptional performance in personal agentic tasks that require planning and orchestration across a range of external apps and services. It zero-shot generalizes to new native tools, MCP servers, and custom skills.
It tackles complex projects significantly faster than Muse Spark, as it is trained to orchestrate multi-agent systems to optimize end-to-end latency. As the main agent, it can gather context, make a plan, and delegate execution across parallel subagents. As a subagent, it adheres to its job, understands available tools, and knows when to escalate back to the main agent.
Muse Spark 1.1 can actively manage its context window of 1 million tokens. It remembers actions, retrieves information from much earlier work, and compacts in a way that keeps the critical steps needed for later work.
Muse Spark 1.1 excels at computer-use workflows that unfold across multiple applications with information changing on-the-fly. It maintains context across extended sessions, adapts to evolving requirements, and navigates unfamiliar interfaces with minimal human intervention.
Rather than reasoning through every desktop step one click at a time, Muse Spark 1.1 understands when to automate and when to use the interface directly. We trained the model to write scripts when automation is faster, click when direct interaction is simpler, and generate batches of actions at each step.

This article introduces an end-to-end guide for building, deploying, and collaborating on an intelligent ticket-triage assistant using AgentScope Java and Alibaba Cloud AgentCore.
This article uses an intelligent ticket-triage assistant to connect the full development, packaging, and deployment workflow: AgentScope Java and the Alibaba Cloud Model Studio decision model (Jev is unavailable on networks in mainland China) implement triage; the application is then deployed as a code package to Alibaba Cloud AgentCore ; both standard and streaming calls are verified. Finally, we show how the assistant joins a Team to participate in task assignment and report review.
Even after an Agent works locally, preparing its runtime, releasing updates, and troubleshooting production issues still require effort. AgentCore supports both code-package and container-image deployment and provides ongoing runtime management. With code-package deployment, developers bundle the application with its runtime dependencies, while the platform supplies the base runtime, eliminating the need to build and maintain a dedicated image for each Agent.
This article is included in the open-source Alibaba Cloud AI Agent Handbook. For an enhanced reading experience, visit: https://aliyun.github.io/ai-agent-handbook/cases/jev/

The login failure requires immediate investigation, whereas the invoice request requires verification of the billing period, ordering entity, and invoice status. After prioritization, operators must still retrieve ticket records and locate the relevant runbook before providing actionable recommendations.
The ticket assistant can prepare this information in advance. A dedicated Model Studio decision model determines the category and priority; the assistant then combines ticket records and runbooks into recommendations for operator review. items.title: GPT-6.1 Terra 发布，评论区：拉完了
items.detailText:
最大亮点是价格降了一半。
在Anthropic正式公开提交IPO招股书的同一天，OpenAI发布了新模型GPT-6.1 Terra。
这是Terra系列时隔三个多月的首次更新，距离9月29日GPT-6.1 Sol发布也已经过去了27天。OpenAI在官方宣传中着重强调：“以更低的价格，提供快速且强大的电脑操作能力。”
“老兄，我们需要的是比Opus 5.5更强的模型。没人关心它是不是更快、更便宜。”
这位网友毫不客气地表示，自己已经几乎不再使用Codex订阅服务，因为它实在没什么用处了。
过去一段时间，Anthropic凭借Claude Opus 5.5在编程等领域赢得了大量关注。不少用户都在期待OpenAI拿出一款足以正面较量的强大模型，结果等来的却是一款主打性价比的中档模型。
GPT-6.1 Terra的API价格为每百万输入Token 1美元、缓存输入Token 0.05美元、输出Token 5美元 ，较上一代输入和输出价格分别下降50%和约58%，且只有GPT-6.1 Sol的一半。
根据OpenAI公布的数据，Terra在编程、视觉理解和电脑操作等方面，较上一代都有明显提升。
在衡量AI编程Agent能力的Terminal-Bench 4.0测试中，Terra的任务完成率从上一代的21.5%提升至50.3%。
在Agents' Last Exam测试中，Terra则拿到了60.0%的成绩，接近Claude Opus 5.5的63.2%。
OpenAI特别强调，在这项电脑操作测试的最高推理档位下，Terra能够以Opus 5.5约九分之一的任务成本，取得接近的成绩。
根据独立AI评测机构Artificial Analysis的测试，在最高推理档位下，Terra的智能指数为48分，比上一代提高6分，但仍低于GPT-6.1 Sol的52分，更比不上Claude Opus 5.5的58分。
Artificial Analysis发现，在其综合智能评测中， Terra完成单个任务的平均成本从1.40美元下降至0.40美元，降幅超过70%。
硬要说的话，6.1 Terra大概就是个“中不溜”模型。价格不高不低，能力不好不差，相比上一代确实有进步。但它连OpenAI自家的Sol都没超过，更谈不上追平Opus 5.5。
但对那些等待OpenAI拿出下一款最强模型的用户来说，恐怕只能得到一种评价：就这？
目前，Terra已通过API开放，Plus、Pro、Enterprise和Edu用户也可以在ChatGPT Work和Codex中使用。但暂时无法在普通Chat对话中调用。
GPT-6.1 Terra也被计入了OpenAI连续28天更新计划，成为这段时间发布的首款新模型。
Tibo表示，这是 OpenAI首款在写作、模型个性以及对用户需求的细腻理解方面取得显著进步的模型。
他还强调，新模型在各方面都有不错的表现，尤其擅长电脑操作，在API和订阅服务中，相比GPT-6.1 Sol还能提供两倍的使用量。
不过，对于Tibo特别强调的写作、个性和细腻理解能力，目前还缺少足够的公开证据。
OpenAI的官方发布稿确实宣称，Terra能够生成更清晰、更自然的文字，但并未提供针对上述三项能力的专项对比测试，也没有展示足以证明其显著进步的评测结果。
电脑操作方面的改进相对直观，在宣传片里，OpenAI展示了Terra根据图片创建3D模型的能力。
OpenAI在官方发布稿中还提到，Terra参与的基准测试包括根据建筑图纸创建3D模型、逐帧检查动画并整理时间码等任务。按照官方的产品定位，它也适合填写表单、匹配商品照片与目录条目等日常工作。
奥特曼则在X上表示：“GPT-6.1 Terra来了！它擅长很多事情，但我们尤其期待电脑操作的这个新时代。”
在官方专门设计的高难度事实性测试中，低推理档位下，Terra的事实错误率从上一代的53.6%下降至16.7%；最高推理档位下，错误率进一步降至4.3%。
有网友直接质问OpenAI，并表示他们真正需要的是一款比GPT-6 Astra更强的前沿模型。
还有网友质疑官方为何没有提供更多Benchmark，以前不都是直接甩一张表出来么。
另外，有网友表示自己已经体验了新模型，电脑操作能力甚至不如6.1 Sol，速度也没有宣传中那么快。
在r/codex，一位网友直接发帖，将这次发布形容为“简直是在给Claude打广告”。
也有人觉得Terra的尴尬之处在于定位。一位网友指出，Terra的API价格是Luna的10倍。
如果追求最低成本，可以使用Luna；如果需要更强的模型，选择Sol似乎更加合理。
甚至连OpenAI的命名方式也遭到了吐槽。由于各档模型的发布时间并不统一，而且不同模型在部分任务上的表现会出现交叉，一些用户已经搞不清Terra、Sol和Astra之间究竟应该怎么选。
面对这些质疑，OpenAI研究员Ted Sanders也在Hacker News上作出了解释。他表示，Terra可能在技术交流方面优于Sol和Astra，在视觉理解与电脑操作方面表现接近，同时速度更快，但在其他大多数任务中稍逊一筹。
当然，社区里也有用户肯定Terra的成本效率，认为能够以低得多的成本完成接近旗舰模型水平的任务，本身就具有价值。
只不过，比起这个“中不溜”的Terra，已经有不少人开始等下一款Astra……以及对家的Fable 5.5了。
在Anthropic正式公开提交IPO招股书的同一天，OpenAI发布了新模型GPT-6.1 Terra。
这是Terra系列时隔三个多月的首次更新，距离9月29日GPT-6.1 Sol发布也已经过去了27天。OpenAI在官方宣传中着重强调：“以更低的价格，提供快速且强大的电脑操作能力。”
“老兄，我们需要的是比Opus 5.5更强的模型。没人关心它是不是更快、更便宜。”
这位网友毫不客气地表示，自己已经几乎不再使用Codex订阅服务，因为它实在没什么用处了。
过去一段时间，Anthropic凭借Claude Opus 5.5在编程等领域赢得了大量关注。不少用户都在期待OpenAI拿出一款足以正面较量的强大模型，结果等来的却是一款主打性价比的中档模型。
GPT-6.1 Terra的API价格为每百万输入Token 1美元、缓存输入Token 0.05美元、输出Token 5美元 ，较上一代输入和输出价格分别下降50%和约58%，且只有GPT-6.1 Sol的一半。
根据OpenAI公布的数据，Terra在编程、视觉理解和电脑操作等方面，较上一代都有明显提升。

items.title: Anthropic招股书终披露：大模型到底赚不赚钱？
items.detailText:
收入暂时跑赢了算力成本。
北京时间昨晚9点（美东时间10月26日上午9点），Anthropic向美国证监会公开提交了招股书，拟在纳斯达克上市，股票代码ANT。 这是全球最前沿的两家大模型公司之一，第一次把自己完整的业绩摊在公众面前。
招股书公开当天，几乎可以说让美股的AI情绪重燃，纳斯达克综合指数涨0.82%，费城半导体指数涨2.82%；而就在上周四，费城半导体指数还单日跌了6.72%。这个秋天，在AI市场的不安中，其他公司的上市纷纷被搁置，只剩Anthropic还在往前推，OpenAI则计划到2027年才上市。
这份招股书的分量在于，过去三年围绕AI吵得最凶的几件事，大模型到底能不能赚钱，算力会不会把收入吃光，企业是不是真的在用，第一次有了正式的答案。而且，这次上市会成为华尔街给AI头部公司定价的标杆，并把二级市场投资人带进一场此前主要由风投、主权基金和科技巨头出钱的竞赛。
至少到今年上半年，业绩还是不错的。2023年，Anthropic全年收入只有4100万美元，今年上半年已经是162.86亿美元，是去年同期的14倍；二季度按会计准则的经营利润是9.74亿美元。上半年账面上807.48亿美元的净亏损，主要来自融资工具的会计重估，不花现金。
在很多人的理解中，这是"一份漂亮的成长股财报"。 但我觉得，这话只说对了一半。 截至6月底，它已签的算力采购承诺和未起租的租约合计约5870亿美元，要在今后近二十年里陆续付出，总额是账上现金和短期投资的四倍多。6月以后，为了锁定更多算力，它又签了新合同、追加了旧合同，往后至少要付的钱又多出约2450亿美元。
这个数很可能还会涨。AI的需求一再超出预期，连Anthropic自己都低估过，英国《金融时报》9月的一篇专栏写道，一年半以前，Anthropic预计2027年全年的收入只有120亿美元，而它今年上半年的收入就已经超过了这个数。需求要是继续这样往上走，它要买的算力只会更多。
这份招股书证明了它的收入已经付得起今天在用的算力，至于接下来这些算力的钱从哪来，还没有答案。
到目前为止，买芯片、建机房的钱，大多是云厂商和芯片商先出，Anthropic再按合同付费。上市以后，这笔钱里有一部分要换成二级市场投资人来出。 他们愿意出多少、按什么价出，最终要看它最强的模型，能不能一直卖得比别人贵。
Anthropic的业务分三层，底层是模型，中间是给开发者搭应用的平台，上面是聊天界面Claude.ai、编程工具Claude Code等自家产品。模型分Mythos、Opus、Sonnet、Haiku四档，能力和价格各不相同，客户按任务选档。
2026年上半年，80%的收入按用量收，按token计量、按所选模型定价，公司管这叫"为智能付费"；另外20%是订阅。从收入渠道看，有48%的收入经亚马逊、谷歌、微软的云市场卖出，由云厂商代收。
主要为Anthropic贡献收入的客户是企业，截至2026年9月30日，过去12个月付费超过10万美元的客户超过11900家，一年前超过950家。截至6月底，这类客户超过6000家，贡献了上半年约74%的收入。招股书没有点名收入占比超过一成的客户，但客户集中度在下降，2025年有两家客户各占收入的12%，合计约11亿美元；到2026年上半年，只剩一家超过10%，占11%。
2024年全年，Anthropic收入3.86亿美元，2025年45.85亿美元，增长1088%；2026年上半年162.86亿美元，是去年同期的14倍。拆到季度看，单季收入五个季度涨了约30倍。
今年三季度的收入，根据招股书里的描述是2024年四季度1.97亿美元的86倍，照此推算约169亿美元，环比增速从二季度的144%回落到约46%， 但增量其实没有塌 ， 三季度比二季度多了约54亿美元，二季度比一季度多了约68亿美元，在我看来，基数效应起了一定作用 。
招股书没有解释三季度的环比增速放缓，但我认为有几件事可能有关：夏季假期客户用量通常会下降；8到9月公司加强了对违规客户的清理，这类客户前九个月约占收入的5%到7%；6月美国商务部对Fable 5和Mythos 5实施全球出口限制，公司对所有客户停用了这两款模型，直到更新安全措施后才解除。
这样的收入增速，在人类历史上几乎没有先例 ；经常有人拿铁路、拿互联网来类比如今的大模型，但从代表性公司的收入增速角度看，这俩技术革命还是碰瓷不了大模型的。
招股书里明确说明，新模型一发布，企业客户就会迁移到最新、最强的版本。2025年11月Opus 4.5发布后，收入环比增速从前一个季度的48%加快到132%；2026年三季度，超过80%的收入来自过去六个月内发布的模型版本。
收入质量层面，直接服务客户的这部分生意，本身很赚钱。招股书没有披露毛利率，按财报附注里分职能的补充表算，上半年收入162.86亿美元，营收成本23.80亿美元，也就是每收入1美元，直接服务客户的算力只花约15美分，毛利率约85%（营收成本不含付给云厂商的渠道费）。钱主要花在下一代模型上，训练模型的算力记在研发费用里，上半年研发费用97.41亿美元，约占收入的六成。
落到经营利润上，2026年二季度，Anthropic按会计准则的经营利润是9.74亿美元，经营利润率8%，按公司剔除股权激励等的调整后口径是19%；一季度还亏损16.67亿美元。这样的盈利能力也是公司反常的地方， 科技公司增速最快的时候，通常也是投入最重、亏得最多的时候，Anthropic却反过来了 ，上半年合计经营亏损已经收窄到6.93亿美元。
翻阅公司的三张表， 对利润的一个重要的贡献是时间差 。Anthropic的算力大部分是多年期长约，通常提前12到18个月订好，从供应商把这批算力交付、可以开始使用的那天起，就按合同付钱，用多用少都要付；收入却是客户当期用多少付多少。
所以，一个季度要付多少算力费，一年多以前就基本定了，今年上半年客户的用量涨得比订好的算力快得多，每1美元算力费换来的收入就多了好几倍。2025年一季度，Anthropic每收入1美元，花在算力和基础设施上的钱是2.51美元；到2026年二季度，只要0.48美元。
但这只对今天这批算力成立 ，公司在招股书里预告，下一批大量新算力上线时，费用会先于收入入账，利润率可能被大幅压下去。而以目前相对微薄的利润看，不排除公司会重回亏损。
至于昨晚刷屏的807.48亿美元净亏损，主要是一笔会计重估。用可转换票据这类工具融资的公司，上市前账上一般都有这一项，估值一涨，票据将来能换到的股份更值钱，负债跟着重估，涨出来的部分记为亏损。

items.title: 金蝶徐嘉祺：出海的下一程，比的是AI管理能力
items.detailText:
金蝶徐嘉祺谈AI助力中企出海的全球化管理新路径
据商务部、国家统计局和国家外汇局联合发布的《2025年度中国对外直接投资统计公报》显示，截至去年年末，我国在境外设立企业5.8万家，遍布189个国家和地区。
过去，企业可以凭借成本、市场和政策优势获得增长机会。如今，贸易规则变化、成本上升和合规要求趋严，让这些优势难以持续。随着出海从产品出口走向本地化经营，企业还必须解决跨国供应链协同、成本控制和全球业务管理等难题。
走出去，只是全球化经营的开始。如何把市场机会转化为持续的利润，越来越考验企业自身的经营能力。
与此同时，AI技术的发展，又为这场变化提供了新的可能。当出海企业开始向内部管理要效益，AI能否帮助它们打破跨国经营中的信息和管理壁垒，让过去依赖大量人力的经营管理变得更加高效？
从金蝶服务中国企业出海的经历中，徐嘉祺观察到，过去这些年，企业出海的重心已经发生了明显变化。
从产品出海到产能出海，再到如今的管理体系出海，中国企业的需求已从最初的出口结算、海外生产管理，逐步转向全球业务的统一管控与协同运营。
过去，中国企业可以借助劳动力成本、税收优惠和贸易政策上的差异，在海外寻找新的增长机会。但如今，支撑这些机会的部分红利正在收窄。
最直观的是成本。2026年1月起，越南将区域最低工资平均上调7.2%。虽然当地仍具有一定的劳动力成本优势，但如果再考虑生产效率、物流运输和供应链配套，海外建厂未必就意味着更低的综合成本。
政策优惠也在发生变化。越南实施的15%全球最低税规则，使部分符合适用条件的大型跨国企业，难以再像过去那样充分享受低税率带来的收益。而在贸易端，美国针对被认定为规避关税的转运商品实施更高税率，也让部分依靠跨境产能布局获取关税优势的商业模式面临新的风险。
机会依然重要，但选对市场、建起工厂，只是完成了全球化经营的第一步。企业能否持续盈利，越来越取决于自身的管理能力。
在国内积累多年的管理经验，未必能够直接复制到海外。不同国家的财税制度、用工规则和商业习惯，要求企业因地制宜；但随着海外业务扩大，总部又必须加强统一管理，避免各地形成相互割裂的经营体系。
管得过细，可能让当地团队失去应对市场的灵活性；各自为政，又容易造成数据割裂、协同低效和管理成本上升。
为了帮助出海企业实现“全球思考，本地经营”，金蝶提出了“统一底座＋本地能力”的解决思路。
按照徐嘉祺的介绍，在这个思路下，不必为每个国家重新开发一套系统，而是在统一的产品架构和数据体系上，通过LocalKits等本地化能力，适配不同国家的语言、财税、电子发票和合规要求。这样既能让海外业务纳入集团管理，又能满足当地经营的实际需要。
“全球化解决的是能力能不能规模复制，本地化解决的是客户愿不愿意真正使用，两者缺一不可。”徐嘉祺认为，本地化绝不是把中文界面翻译成当地语言，还要深入当地的业务流程、用户习惯和服务体系。
为此，金蝶不仅需要调整产品，还要在重点市场建立本地营销、交付和客户服务团队，与当地财税、咨询及实施伙伴合作，并在一些地区布局贴近一线需求的研发能力。
浙江哈尔斯是国内杯壶行业知名品牌，他们把国内管理经验复制到泰国，却遇到BOI保税物料申报核销、多币种结算、中泰准则报表合并与三语税务申报等难题。公司规划以金蝶ERP为底座，把合规做成系统执行规则：保税属性写进物料、仓库和单据，保税料件仅限保税仓进出，报关与销售单证自动带出BOI标识，增值税与预扣税随单计算，中泰两套准则并行记账。2023年一期投产、2025年上半年二期建成，年产能合计3000万只；基地已能独立接单、独立核算并应对海关核查，上半年营收1.99亿元，占总收入12.67%。
最直接的变化发生在市场拓展环节。过去，进入一个新市场，往往需要投入大量人力进行多语言沟通、需求分析和客户服务。如今，AI可以承担其中一部分重复性工作，降低语言和知识获取的门槛，帮助金蝶以更低的成本触达和服务海外客户。
徐嘉祺介绍，传统ERP主要按照预设流程运行，业务操作仍依赖人工。而随着金蝶AI套件与金蝶灵基的结合，系统开始能够理解业务任务、连接企业数据、调用业务流程，并在授权范围内自主完成部分操作，重要决策和例外情况则仍由人负责。
从产品适配到客户服务，再到AI参与企业管理，金蝶试图建立的，不只是一套能够在不同国家运行的软件，而是一种能够持续复制、又能适应当地需求的管理服务能力。
伴随中国客户走向海外，金蝶逐步打开了国际市场。但要获得更大的发展空间，仅仅跟随客户出海还不够，金蝶开始将目光投向海外本土企业。
与跟随中企出海不同，争取海外本土客户，意味着金蝶需要直接参与当地市场竞争，凭借产品的本地化能力、交付效率和持续服务赢得客户。

items.title: The AI Agent Era Doesn't Need More Data — It Needs a Semantic Layer
items.description: The AI Agent Era Doesn't Need More Data — It Needs a Semantic Layer This article introduces UnifiedModel, an open-source semantic layer that organizes enterprise data into a queryable object graph for AI agents. Alibaba Cloud Native Co
items.detailText:
This article introduces UnifiedModel, an open-source semantic layer that organizes enterprise data into a queryable object graph for AI agents.
In the AI Agent era, what's really missing isn't more data — it's an open map of the system.
Agents have improved fast over the past year. They write code, call tools, plan across multiple steps, and search back and forth across logs, metrics, traces, and change tickets. But drop one into a real production system and ask, "What is actually wrong with payment-gateway right now?" and it will still happily produce an answer that sounds authoritative and is quietly dangerous.
The cause isn't wrong information from any single tool. CPU at 88% is correct. P99 at 2150 ms is correct. That one slow trace is correct too. The problem is that all of these are only symptoms. The Agent has plenty of fragments, but it doesn't know which object each fragment belongs to, how the objects connect, who depends on whom, or which upstream configuration just changed.
This is the engineering version of the blind men and the elephant. Metrics, logs, traces, tickets, and code repositories each touch a real piece of the animal. No single structure tells the Agent what the whole elephant looks like.
The usual first reaction is to give the Agent more capability:
Every one of these makes sense, but they add capability and data. They don't address system structure. Connecting to every system is not the same as understanding it. Having every fragment in context is not the same as knowing how they relate.
What's missing is a semantic layer — a structure that captures the objects, relationships, fields, evidence, and action context of the real system.
To an Agent, a complex system should not be a pile of tables, APIs, and log files. It should be a queryable world model:
In information science, this idea is rooted in ontology — the study of what kinds of things exist in a domain and how they relate. UnifiedModel brings that thinking into engineering systems, describing a digital twin object graph with a very small set of unified primitives.
A semantic layer does not copy all your data into a new database, nor chop documents into segments for a vector store. Think of it as a system map for the Agent. The Agent can still call Prometheus, Simple Log Service (SLS), Elasticsearch (ES), MySQL, Kubernetes, and the CMDB — but it starts from objects rather than from a database engine, follows relationships to the evidence, and then generates an executable query or action plan.

items.detailText:
This article introduces HiRoute, an open-source local routing engine that intelligently directs AI agent tasks to the right models to cut costs and boost workflow efficiency.
An agent task can move from research and code reading to design and debugging. Each step calls for different model capabilities. Use your strongest model throughout, and routine work consumes valuable subscription capacity. Switch to an economy model, and you risk getting stuck on a critical decision or a difficult bug. With several agents, subscriptions, and providers' APIs available, working out how to combine them becomes another task in itself.
The Higress team built HiRoute to make that combination easier. HiRoute is a local engine for intelligent agent routing and collaboration. Keep using the agent you know, let economy models handle routine work, and bring in a primary model for demanding stages. When a task benefits from a separate worker, delegate it to another agent. The aim is to make your existing tools and compute work together, while reducing unnecessary spending and manual handoffs.
We previewed HiRoute's open-source plans in the keynote at AGNTCon + MCPCon China and formally open sourced it at the Apsara Conference. You can now download it, use it, and help build it.
Figure 1. Task routing and model routing can be enabled independently or used together.
HiRoute grew out of three kinds of fragmentation we encounter every day.
Models have different strengths. Summarizing research, reasoning through a difficult problem, writing code, and handling long context all make different demands on capability and cost.
Agents have different workflows. Some people prefer Codex's execution flow, others know Claude Code best, and many use additional tools for research or specialized engineering work.
Compute is spread across subscriptions, API keys from different providers, and local services. Capabilities you have already paid for or configured can be difficult to use together.
Figure 2. Agent applications, frameworks, and runtime infrastructure keep diversifying. Users need a simpler way to combine them.
Long tasks add a time dimension to these choices. A job may start with research, move through design and implementation, and end with validation and difficult repairs. A model that works well for gathering information may not be enough for an architectural decision. Once the hard part is solved, the remaining steps may no longer need the most expensive capabilities.
Users therefore care about the cost of the whole task: whether the strongest model is used where it matters, whether subscription capacity is reserved for difficult work, whether failures allow a controlled handoff, and what evidence can inform the next choice.

items.detailText:
Streamline tasks with the new Gemini business hub. Connect Google apps, generate on-brand visuals, and get financial insights. See what’s new.
New Gemini tools for small business owners
Gemini’s new tools — including a dedicated business landing page — help small business owners free up time and focus on what started their companies: their passion.
Gemini is launching a new central hub to help small business owners manage tasks, finances, and marketing in one place. You can now connect your existing apps and upload brand guidelines to generate consistent, professional visuals automatically. Look for these new tools to roll out globally in the coming days to help you save time and focus on your business.
Gemini is launching new tools to help small business owners save time and get more done. It can now handle tasks like creating brand visuals, organizing messy financial data, and connecting to other apps. These updates let entrepreneurs focus on their passions instead of boring paperwork. Business owners around the world are already using it to grow their companies and solve tricky problems.
Tens of millions of small business owners are using Gemini today to brainstorm future products, manage customer feedback, and analyze business performance. Today, we’re announcing new tools designed to give these entrepreneurs their time back so they can focus on what started it all: their passion.
We’re introducing a new business landing page designed to help small business owners streamline their daily tasks. From this central hub, they can build their brand, analyze finances, understand customer insights, and more.
We’re also making it easy to connect Gemini to Google tools like Google Business Profile, Google Ads, and Google Workspace, as well as third-party connected apps like Adobe, Canva, Dropbox, Shopify, Wix, Zoho, and Xero.
Businesses can now define their brand style in Gemini by uploading their website, brand kit, fonts, or color palettes. When paired with the power of Nano Banana 2.1 (our latest image generation model), Gemini can now deliver end-to-end visual results for new product launches or ongoing marketing campaigns.
